name: reduce

test_list.description: push_user/assistant/system/error append entries in order and survive interleaved events.
A skipped sequence number returns ReduceError::SeqGap and leaves the state unchanged.
A repeated or older sequence number returns ReduceError::OutOfOrder and leaves the state unchanged.
The first folded record may carry any sequence number (resuming from a snapshot).
A started tool is shown collapsed; toggling one entry expands only it; the global flag applies to entries without an override.
The global expand/collapse flag resets per-entry overrides.
ToolExecutionCompleted marks the matching entry succeeded/failed with its latency.
A completion with no recorded start creates a finished entry instead of failing.
ModelRequestCompleted accumulates prompt/completion/cached tokens, cost in micro-USD and latency.
DecisionMade records the S1 latency.
WorkerRestarted, CircuitTripped and DeadLettered update the status snapshot.
SessionStarted adds a row, SessionClosed marks it closed.
Goal active time counts only the periods between start/resume and pause.
Events without a view effect only advance the sequence and never panic.
Raising effort at Max and lowering it at Low change nothing.
Switching models restores each model's last effort in memory.
Auto and Plan toggle.
insta: serialized ViewState of a fresh session (characterization).
insta: ViewState after a canonical conversation event script (characterization).
insta: ViewState after error entry and worker/circuit events (characterization).
insta: goal line active and paused (characterization).
ViewState serializes to JSON and back unchanged.
Folding the same sequence-respecting record list into two fresh states gives equal states.
Any rejected record leaves the state unchanged.

dependencies: polaris_sdk::ids::{Seq, Cid, FrameId, SessionId, ModelId, MicroUsd, TokenCount}

inputs.name: record
inputs.description: Next record; its seq must be last+1.

output_description: Updated view state, or a typed error with the state unchanged.
